cases.title: Panel: Hint after a partial check gives a hint and changes nothing

rubric.reason: Turn 3 locates what is still off ("Title's Scale keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds, and so are its Opacity keys at the same times"), Turn 4 gives only how-to steps ("press **S**... press **F9**"), and the mentor neither calls `set_ease` on a learner's pair nor offers to fix them.

The only `set_ease` call is the Turn 2 demo on `demo_target` (`1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1`), and that turn hands back the rest by name: "The other three are yours to do: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Say done when you've eased them."

After the check showed two still_linear pairs, Turn 3 located them ("Title's Scale and Opacity keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s are still diamonds"), and neither Turn 3 nor the Turn 4 hint ("Drag a box around the four diamonds... then press F9") called `set_ease` or offered to fix them.

The only edit was one `set_ease` on `demo_target` (Title Position 0.5–1.5 s), and Turn 2 hands back the rest by name: "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say done."
